reason: A Windows-focused launcher plugin that adds a DSH sidebar button and generates files to install dependencies and start DeepSeek Harness with one click.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 一键启动器，并可在 DSH 侧边栏添加按钮以生成启动文件。
summaries.en: Provides a Windows one-click launcher for DeepSeek Harness and can add a DSH sidebar button that generates the required startup files.

capabilities: Creates Windows batch and executable launcher files
Installs dsh dependencies with npm on first run
Starts a local DeepSeek Harness process
Adds a sidebar launcher button to the DSH Web interface
